education: BA, Economics with minor in German, Texas Tech University
biography:
Commercial Real Estate, Data Centers and Telecommunications Leader with 20 years experience. 

Focus includes executing unique corporate real estate strategies to increase shareholder value - structuring transactions, acquisitions, divestments, taxation, municipal negotiations, construction and development.

Proven track record of managing real estate assets with a Telecom component (cell towers, fiber, solar, and data centers), as well as buying and selling office buildings, warehouses, retail, data centers, cell towers, and raw land. 

Extensive experience managing a Real Estate Owned portfolio (REO), involving mitigating risk and maximizing value through leasing, pre-marketing, sales, and cell tower leases. Assemble and guide high-performance teams to service multimillion-dollar real estate portfolios, maximize profitability, and improve internal rate of return (IRR). Plan and execute strategy based on best practices and business intelligence to drive sustainability in a regulatory-compliant manner. Cultivate and sustain professional business partnerships, leveraging to align with critical initiatives. Deliver impactful results while leading teams in demanding, dynamic environments.
